BMW.reason: BMW names carry the engine and drive (X1 SDRIVE18D, 320D XDRIVE, 118D): the family is the SUV code or the series number.

MERCEDES-BENZ.reason: Mercedes names carry the engine and drive (GLC 220 D 4MATIC, AMG A 35 4MATIC): the family is the class code.

MERCEDES-AMG.reason: Mercedes-AMG names carry the engine and drive (AMG GT 63 4MATIC+): the family is the AMG line.

AUDI.reason: Audi names carry the body and engine (A3 SPORTBACK, Q5 SB, RS 6 AVANT): the family is the model code.

PORSCHE.reason: Porsche names carry the version (911 CARRERA 4 GTS, MACAN 4S): the family is the first word.

VOLKSWAGEN.reason: Volkswagen lists each electric ID. car by battery and power (ID.4 PRO 210 KW) and a few others by version; T CROSS, T-ROC and the rest are single models.

MASERATI.reason: Maserati names carry the trim (GRECALE MODENA, GHIBLI TROFEO): the family is the model.

FERRARI.reason: Ferrari names carry the body (296 GTS, SF90 SPIDER) and are spelled with and without a space (SF 90, 12 CILINDRI).

CUPRA.reason: Cupra names carry the engine and trim (LEON SP E-HYBRID150, BORN 170 KW 60 63 KWH): the family is the first word.

MINI.reason: MINI names carry the trim (COOPER SE, JCW COUNTRYMAN ALL4): the family is the body name, else the trim line.

LEXUS.reason: Lexus names carry the engine (NX450H+, UX300H): the family is the two-letter model code.

SKODA.reason: Skoda names carry the battery or trim (ENYAQ 85X, OCTAVIA RS): the family is the first word.

VOLVO.reason: Volvo lists the Cross Country versions apart (V60 CROSS COUNTRY): the family is the first word.

HYUNDAI.reason: Hyundai names carry the fuel (I20 BI-FUEL) and are spelled IONIQ5 or IONIQ 5 or I 30: the family is the model with its number.

RENAULT.reason: Renault names carry the powertrain (CAPTUR E-TECH HYBRID, CLIO AUTOSCUOLA): the family is the first word.

OPEL.reason: Opel names carry the body or version (ASTRA SPORTS TOURER, ZAFIRA LIFE): the family is the first word.

BENTLEY.reason: Bentley names carry the engine and coachbuilder version (BENTAYGA SPEED, CONTINENTAL GTC AZURE): the family is the model.

ROLLS ROYCE.reason: Rolls-Royce lists the Black Badge versions apart (BLACK BADGE GHOST): the family is the model.
